prompt: Unseen service: compare a Helm chart with a Kustomize base/overlay, detect hidden input and identity defects, execute a bounded disposable release, recover from a stateful failure, and defend the ownership design.
deliverables: Environment, source, dependency, renderer, input and render identities.
Helm-versus-Kustomize decision tied to publisher/consumer/environment ownership.
Values precedence/type defect and corrected schema contract.
Kustomize patch, generated-name, selector and ownership analysis.
Validation ladder including server dry-run and normalized diff.
Bounded install/upgrade plan with abort and cleanup conditions.
Hook/CRD/data compatibility analysis and recovery decision.
Exact cleanup proof and a delayed changed-case explanation.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unseen package, overlays and injected failures.
Learner has namespace scope only; reviewer owns policy, CRDs, data and final cleanup.
No production context, real secret, external registry credential, cluster-admin or irreversible migration.
Evidence is tied to UTC time and exact source/input/render/release/object identities.
At least one rejected hypothesis and one negative validation are preserved.
Reviewer observes user-path recovery, cleanup and delayed retrieval.
